$comment: engine.census balance/thread configuration (FEAT-133 / feat.citycensus). Every numeric value below is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass — the balance-number regime, same convention as feat.maintenance AC-16 and engine.finance AC-21. Units are stated per entry; tests check direction and structure, never a pinned magnitude.

meta.balanceRegime: Every numeric entry below is a disclosed placeholder pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass (the balance-number regime). Units are stated per entry; a downstream consumer never has to guess whether a figure is years, miles, points, or a fraction.

lifespanMeanYears.disclosure: placeholder — mean citizen lifespan, pending Aaron's balance pass (§18). Used only as an observation benchmark, never a census-side mutation.

lifespanSpreadYears.disclosure: placeholder — lifespan spread (±), pending Aaron's balance pass (§18). Observation benchmark only.

retirementAgeYears.disclosure: placeholder — retirement age, pending Aaron's balance pass (§18). The bio's retirement month = birth month + this value (ASM-646).

annualMileage.disclosure: placeholder — car annual mileage, pending Aaron's balance pass (AC-11's short-lived car life-history benchmark).

crimeEducationElasticity.disclosure: placeholder — education→crime elasticity, pending Aaron's balance pass. AC-14 checks the direction is data-derived, never this specific slope.

blueWhiteCollarBaselineBlue.disclosure: placeholder — §45 blue-collar baseline. Observation benchmark only: the blue/white split is EMERGENT from sector data (AC-17), never applied as a hardcoded ratio.

blueWhiteCollarBaselineWhite.disclosure: placeholder — §45 white-collar baseline. Observation benchmark only; see blueWhiteCollarBaselineBlue.

happinessWeightPhysical.disclosure: placeholder — §18 wellbeing=f(physical,mental,satisfaction) weight composition, pending Aaron's balance pass.

happinessWeightMental.disclosure: placeholder — §18 wellbeing weight composition, pending Aaron's balance pass.

happinessWeightSatisfaction.disclosure: placeholder — §18 wellbeing weight composition, pending Aaron's balance pass.

consistencyCheckInLagTicks.disclosure: placeholder — CC least-check-in lag beyond which an object is flagged lost, pending Aaron's balance pass (ASM-646).

crimeRate.disclosure: placeholder — regulator crime-too-high alarm level, pending Aaron's balance pass (§28).

unfedFraction.disclosure: placeholder — regulator unfed alarm level, pending Aaron's balance pass (§40/§18).

uneducatedFraction.disclosure: placeholder — regulator uneducated alarm level, pending Aaron's balance pass (§27).

uneducatedAttainmentFloor.disclosure: placeholder — attainment floor below which a citizen counts as 'uneducated', pending Aaron's balance pass (§27).
